resources.string: Encrypt and save backup password on this device

Includes records, assets, categories, photos, settings, AI chats, saved AI API keys and custom wallpapers. Cloud files are encrypted. A lost backup password cannot be recovered. Connection credentials are excluded.

Save connection credentials protected by the system keystore? Selecting Remember also saves the backup password, which automatic backups require. The first backup creates an encrypted vault; other devices must use the same backup password.
Cannot read or save protected configuration. Disconnect and configure again.
Check the HTTPS endpoint, credentials, backup password (8+ characters) and retention (1–365).
Wi-Fi is not connected. Continuing may use mobile data. Initial image uploads and restores can use substantial data. Continue?
Cancel automatic backup and clear all local cloud credentials and saved passwords? Cloud backups will remain.
Not started. Save your configuration, then test or back up.
Merge restore complete. Reopen pages to view changes.
Further processing cancelled. Any completed backup remains in history.
Waiting for Wi-Fi to resume automatic backup
Wrong password, damaged backup or unsupported format. Operation stopped.
Authentication failed. Check credentials and permissions.
Operation failed. Check the network, service permissions and free space, then retry.
Both local and backup asset balances changed. Choose how to handle the conflict.
Restore preview ready. Review and confirm.
Transferred: %1$.2f MB · Additional upload estimate: %2$.2f MB (verification and metadata traffic extra)
Delete this cloud backup? Images referenced by other retained backups will remain.
Merge the backup into local data without replacing the database? Existing records follow merge rules. Choosing backup balances applies conflicting balances.
Backup succeeded, but history cleanup was incomplete. It will retry after the next backup.
Directory for cloud backups. Default: cardtally.
At least 8 characters. Encrypts backups; separate from the login password.
Keep the latest 1–365 automatic backups; default 15. Manual backups are not automatically deleted.
The backup password does not match this cloud directory. Use the password set for the first backup, not the login password.
Cloud data or the service response has an unsupported format or is damaged. The operation stopped.
The service does not support required read/write or overwrite protection operations. Check its WebDAV/S3 configuration.
The endpoint, directory or target file was not found. Check the address and path.
The service is limiting requests. Try again later.
The service returned a redirect. Enter the final HTTPS endpoint and retry.
Enter a complete HTTPS URL without embedded credentials, query or fragment.
Use 3–63 letters, digits, dots or hyphens.
Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
The directory cannot contain . or .. path segments.
The service did not honor overwrite protection. Backup creation stopped to protect existing cloud data.
The cloud path conflicts or the destination parent directory is missing. Check whether a file has the same name as the backup directory.
